biography:
Strategic accounts owner - for Data Centre site selection, deal negotiation, and financial & legal due diligence for new sites across KSA.

I oversee the full lifecycle of key account development—from identifying opportunities and shaping joint go-to-market strategies, to negotiating complex deals and ensuring seamless execution across cross-functional teams. My work spans joint ventures, co-selling agreements, and strategic integrations that position Tonomus as a partner of choice in AI, cloud, and data center ecosystems.

With over 20 years of global experience—including 5+ years in the GCC—I’ve held leadership roles at Intel, AWS, Edgnex, and Tonomus, building a strong track record of success in enterprise sales, infrastructure strategy, and partner enablement. I combine commercial acumen with deep technical understanding to act as a trusted advisor to C-level stakeholders and a catalyst for long-term growth.
